    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_a1" sourceRef="Start_art" targetRef="Task_review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_a2" sourceRef="Task_review" targetRef="End_art"/>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_sla">
      <bpmn:text>Must complete within one business day.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_sla" sourceRef="Task_review" targetRef="TextAnnotation_sla" associationDirection="None"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
